main_text.l: Meritóque Deus justus judex graviter indignatur iis, quos vel con-

exercuit, nec attonitos reddunt, nec ad pietatem & saniora consilia
inflectunt, nec ex securitatis, & collusionis cum mundo veterno
expergefaciunt. Propter omnem moechationem, ita Deus Jerem.III.
8.9. queritur, quam exercuit aversa Israel, dimisi quidem illam, & de-

l.i: di ipsi libellum repudii. Et non timuit perfida Juda soror ejus, & ivit,

page.notes: Left margin notes are transcribed in full: "Securitas inprimis hic Deo invisa est." and "Judicia Dei omnia justa sunt." Doubtful readings: the Greek after "S.Theodoretus" (πικρὸν ἐστι, ἀχαλινωτῶν δεσπότης) is uncertain and marked [?]. The Greek phrase after "id" and the Greek word in the Angelus sentence are not clearly legible; the latter is marked illegible. The two Hebrew words after "Imperator," are uncertain and marked [?]. The dash after "contemptum" is treated as a separator, not a hyphen. "Adoni.Bezek" is printed with a point, kept as printed. No page number, running head or signature is visible.
